metaTitle: We Install Christmas Lights | 2026 Award Winner
metaDescription: We Install Christmas Lights won our 2026 Holiday & Christmas Lighting award for Mississauga, Ontario. 740+ homes decorated, 5.0-star rating.
summary: We Install Christmas Lights is Southwestern Ontario's highest-volume holiday lighting company by their own account, having decorated over 740 homes and lit 921 residential trees. The team runs an all-inclusive service model, handling design, installation, mid-season maintenance, takedown and storage in a single package.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: We Install Christmas Lights offers residential installation, full-season holiday service, light takedown, year-long storage, Govee light installation and commercial installation, plus Christmas decorating. Handling takedown and off-season storage as part of the package means a homeowner does not need to find space to store lights or find time to take them down after the season.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company states most installations are completed in a single day, with custom roofline design worked out ahead of the install date. It reports a 96% client return rate and a 5.0-star rating across more than 80 Google reviews, and crews reach Mississauga, Oakville, Hamilton, Brampton and 18 other named communities.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One reviewer in St. Thomas described the service as taking the hassle out of holiday preparations, praising professional and timely installation and takedown, and specifically noting attention to detail. A London couple said the team transformed their home for the season and complimented the efficiency of both installation and takedown.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company's service area covers Mississauga, Oakville, Hamilton, Brampton and 18 additional communities across South-Western Ontario, a wide multi-city footprint for a single holiday lighting business. Confirm which specific communities near you are covered before booking, since the named list is only a partial sample.

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: We Install Christmas Lights was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top holiday and Christmas lighting company serving the Mississauga area, based on public services, reviews and reported scale, with no fee for consideration or winning.

faq.q: Do they take the lights down after the season?
faq.a: Yes, light takedown and year-long storage are both listed as part of their full-season holiday service.

faq.q: How many reviews do they have?
faq.a: The company states a 5.0-star rating across more than 80 Google reviews and a 96% client return rate.

faq.q: Do they only do residential work?
faq.a: No, commercial installation is also listed among their services alongside residential decorating.
